description: This file contains tests and implementation for inter-process communication (IPC) using a simple IPC mechanism. It includes command handling, server start/stop, client requests, and various test commands to verify IPC functionality.

methods.name: app__unhandled_command
methods.description: Handles unknown IPC commands by sending an error message back to the client.

methods.name: app__big_command
methods.description: Generates and replies with a large buffer of sequential lines to test long responses.

methods.name: app__chunk_command
methods.description: Replies with a series of lines, chunked incrementally to test response chunking.

methods.name: app__slow_command
methods.description: Replies slowly with lines, simulating an expensive response to test handling of slow responses.

methods.name: app__sendbytes_command
methods.description: Processes a command to send a large number of bytes with a specific character ballast.

methods.name: test_app_cb
methods.description: Main application callback that handles specific commands like 'quit', 'ping', 'big', 'chunk', 'slow', and 'sendbytes'.

methods.name: bg_wait_cb
methods.description: Callback to wait for the background IPC server process to be ready.

methods.name: daemon__start_server
methods.description: Starts the IPC server as a background process.

methods.name: client__probe_server
methods.description: Checks if the IPC server is active and listening.

methods.name: client__send_ipc
methods.description: Sends a command token to the IPC server and prints the response.

methods.name: client__stop_server
methods.description: Sends a quit command to stop the IPC server and waits for shutdown.

methods.name: do_sendbytes
methods.description: Sends a large message with ballast bytes to test message chunking.

methods.name: client__sendbytes
methods.description: Prepares and sends a large byte message to the server.

methods.name: multiple_thread_proc
methods.description: Thread function that sends multiple IPC requests.

methods.name: client__multiple
methods.description: Starts multiple client threads to send IPC requests concurrently.

methods.name: cmd__simple_ipc
methods.description: Main command handler for the 'simple-ipc' subcommands, including server start/stop and client requests.
